newsitem.title: USA: Kinark Corp completes rights offering.
newsitem.headline: Kinark Corp completes rights offering.

text.p: Kinark Corp said Thursday it completed its rights offering of about 700,000 common shares on November 8.

Kinark offered its stockholders of record September 27 one non-transferable right for each share of common stock held. The right entitled holders to purchase one share of Kinark common stock at a subscription price of $3 each.
The offering generated gross proceeds of about $2.1 million, Kinark said. The company plans to use the proceeds to buy the 27-percent stake in Rogers Galvanizing Co it doesn't already own.
Kinark provides metal corrosion protection for commercial, construction and industrial markets.
The stock was unchanged at three.
